clips.start_words: Relationships give us more emotional pain
clips.send: Someone who just went through a brutal breakup sends this to a friend losing it over an ex, proof that the wreckage is real and they are not overreacting.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says relationships cause more emotional pain than any other part of life - more than money ever could.

We chase connection through food, status, sex, even making money, without ever naming what we are actually looking for.

Then he tells the story of a close friend whose wife asked for a divorce. The man cried every single day. Kevin says he was so broken, it was almost like he wanted to give up entirely.

Losing money, you can rebuild. Losing the person who made you feel connected hits somewhere money cannot reach.

If a breakup has ever flattened you like that, what actually pulled you back?
